title: The Club
subtitle: The history, values and achievements of Dynamo City

history.title: Club history
history.paragraph1: Founded in 1985, FC Dynamo City was born from the passion of a handful of football enthusiasts from the Dynamic district. Starting out in the regional championship, the club steadily grew into one of the country's leading sides.
history.paragraph2: Today, Dynamo City brings together thousands of supporters at every home match and keeps developing its own academy, nurturing a new generation of players true to the club's spirit: hard work, passion and victory.

values.title: Our values
values.excellence: Excellence — we strive for the highest standard in our play, our preparation and the way the club is run, raising the bar every day.
values.passion: Passion — football brings us together: players, staff and supporters who write the history of Dynamo City as one.
